name: Logea Island
objection: For: tourism board map highlights it, easy boat ride from Alotau. Against: the named thing is a lodge (operators are not spots) and a single source.

name: Tawali
objection: Single source, zero views, and the access is via the resort. Counter: a named world-class dive site is the draw of the province.

name: Deacon's Reef
objection: For: same source as Tawali calls it world-renowned. Against: one list mention, no pin, no description; cannot be placed without owner-supplied coordinates.

name: Gonubalabala
objection: One source, no pin yet, and the pin must be resolved from a map feature. Counter: named twice on the same page (list and manta caption).

name: Wahoo Point
objection: For: board calls it world-renowned. Against: one bare mention, nothing sourced about what is there, no coordinates.

name: Kiriwina
objection: For: the island where all visitors land. Against: near-duplicate of the group entry; dancing is tied to a yam festival (event). Keep only one of Kiriwina or the group.

name: Woodlark Island
objection: Remote and one source, no facilities sourced; but listed as its own destination in the province guide.

name: Dobu Island
objection: For: counted source plus 3,097 views, volcanic. Against: no listing of its own, no visitor facilities, little to do.
